name: @local/vibe64-genesis
description: The Vibe64-owned interpretation boundary for opaque Genesis Stack sections.

surfaces.summary: Uses Genesis transport while Vibe64 owns workspace setup, Outputs, preview identity, application deployment, Staging data, and packaging contracts.
Owns the strict vibe64.packaging.v1 parser, normalized model and Environment-defaults resolution for the opaque Packaging section.
Owns the agent-readable specs of every Vibe64 Stack section, generated from the parsers' entry tables.
Owns the connected-project package type vocabulary shared by Stack parsing, connection validation, schemas and the client.
Owns a Deployment service's id grammar and the most services a Deployment has, shared by the Deployment parser, Add a service and its form.
Owns which declared Stack resources a Development run needs (a bucket is not one: the app uses its own default storage), shared by Env, workspace setup and Preview's start check.
